product: Productboard connector is available in Beta
tagline: The managed Productboard connector is now available in Lakeflow Connect in Beta.
what_it_does: The managed Productboard connector is now available in Lakeflow Connect in Beta. Workspace admins can control access to this feature from the Previews page. Use the connector to ingest product hierarchy, roadmap, objectives, customer feedback notes, and workspace member data from Productboard into Databricks.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
